title: Record cable disconnection in interface history
steps: Review the loaded uplink0 interfaces on Akron Edge A and Akron Edge B.
Open Akron Edge A's uplink0 interface and inspect its Connection panel.
Open the interface's Changelog tab and inspect the listed changes.
Open the timestamp of the latest Updated Interface entry and inspect its Difference panel.

video_guide.summary: Inspect a disconnected interface and its four-entry Changelog, then open the earlier connection update.

chapters.note: The filtered Interfaces list shows uplink0 on Akron Edge A and Akron Edge B.

chapters.label: Open Akron Edge A’s uplink0 interface.

chapters.note: The interface’s Connection panel says Not Connected.
The table shows all four entries: a Cable Termination deletion, one Updated Interface entry, and two creation entries. No later Interface update appears above the deletion.

chapters.label: Open the timestamp of the Updated Interface entry.

chapters.note: The Difference panel shows cable changing from null to 128 and cable_end from null to A: this is the earlier connection event.
